categories.title: Facials
categories.about: Refresh and rejuvenate your skin with our premium facial treatments at Glamour Day Spa. Our skilled therapists use high-quality products and advanced techniques to deeply cleanse, hydrate, and revitalize your complexion. From anti-aging facials to soothing treatments for sensitive skin, each session is personalized to meet your unique needs.

services.name: Express Facial
services.description: A quick yet refreshing treatment in just 30 minutes. Ideal before an event or during your lunch break.

services.name: Signature Facial
services.description: Our Signature Facial is personalized according to your skin type and concerns. Whether your skin is dry, oily, sensitive, or combination, our licensed estheticians will customize the treatment for optimal results.

services.name: Gentleman Facial
services.description: Tailored for men’s skin, this treatment deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and hydrates while soothing irritation from shaving and environmental stress. Leaves skin refreshed, balanced, and ready to take on the day.

services.name: Acne Skin Facial
services.description: Specially designed to deeply cleanse and decongestant pores, normalize oil production, and calm inflamed skin.

services.name: Pigment Facial
services.description: A brightening treatment designed to even skin tone, fade dark spots, and restore a radiant, glowing complexion. Perfect for revitalizing dull or sun-damaged skin.

services.name: Oxygen Machines Facial
services.description: A rejuvenating treatment that infuses pure oxygen and nutrients into the skin to boost hydration, brighten your complexion, and leave your face feeling fresh and radiant.

services.name: Microdermabrasion Facial
services.description: A powerful exfoliating treatment that resurfaces the skin to reduce fine lines, scars, sun damage, and dullness — revealing a smoother, brighter, more youthful complexion.

services.name: GM Collin Algomask Treatment
services.description: This enriched thermo-corrective cooling treatment provides immediate and long-lasting hydration. Designed to minimize the appearance of redness and provide ultimate relief to sensitive skin.

services.name: GM Collin Hydro-Lifting Treatment
services.description: A unique clinical treatment, specifically formulated to work on the face and neck, providing intense immediate hydration and giving the skin immediately” lifted appearance “.

services.name: GM Collin Collagen Treatment
services.description: An Exclusive highly renowned intensive anti-aging treatment hydrates, rejuvenates , tightens, and reconfigures the skin surface to reduce visible signs of aging.

services.name: Ultrasonic Firm Up Skin Facial
services.description: This advanced facial uses ultrasonic technology to lift, tone, and rejuvenate the skin. Gentle soundwave vibrations stimulate collagen production, improve elasticity, and enhance product absorption — leaving your complexion firmer, smoother, and more radiant.

services.name: Black Doll Beauty
services.description: This advanced treatment deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and tightens the skin. It targets acne, enlarged pores, and uneven texture — leaving your complexion smoother, brighter, and flawlessly refreshed.

services.name: Teen Facial
services.description: Designed specifically for young skin, our Teen Facial deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and hydrates to help combat breakouts and balance oil production. Perfect for learning healthy skincare habits and achieving a fresh, clear glow. What's Included: Gentle cleanse, Skin consultation, Exfoliation, Light extractions, Acne treatment (if needed), Calming mask, Moisturizer, and SPF Benefits: Reduces breakouts, Clears clogged pores, Controls oil production, Builds healthy skincare habits, Boosts confidence

services.name: Facial Lymphatic Drainage Massage
services.description: Experience a gentle, relaxing facial lymphatic drainage treatment designed to help reduce the appearance of puffiness, encourage natural lymphatic flow, and refresh your facial contours.

services.name: Back Facial
services.description: Back facials can be beneficial in cleansing those tough-to-reach spots, targeting a variety of skin care needs such as clogged pores, back acne, and dehydrated skin.

services.name: Sensitive Skin Facial
services.description: Essential oils cleanse, detoxify, and rejuvenate the skin. Includes deep cleansing, exfoliation, pressure point massage, and a hydrating mask with head, neck, and shoulder massage.

services.name: HydraFacial Treatment
services.description: Reveal healthier, smoother, and more radiant skin with HydraFacial® — one of the most popular non-invasive facial treatments available today.

services.name: Bio Lifting Tightening Facial
services.description: A rejuvenating treatment that infuses pure oxygen and nutrients into the skin to boost hydration, brighten your complexion, and leave your face feeling fresh and radiant.

services.name: Ultra Sound and Photo Rejuvenation
services.description: A high-tech facial using ultrasound waves and light therapy to boost collagen, smooth fine lines, and brighten the skin — leaving your complexion firm, radiant, and refreshed.

services.name: GM Collin Oxygenating Treatment
services.description: This revolutionary treatment for all age group designed to clear acne , improve complexion, and breathe life back into dull, fatigued, and stressed skin. Brightens and hydrates to provide a younger -looking skin.

services.name: GM Collin Sea "C" Spa Treatment
services.description: A powerful antioxidant, anti-aging skin care designed to delay the signs of aging and to revitalize the skin.

services.name: GM Collin Botinal Treatment
services.description: Innovative and non-invasive, with instant and long-lasting visible results, perfectly describes this treatment. Benefits: Smooths expression lines and wrinkles for an instant radiance boost.

services.name: LED Light Machine Facial
services.description: A cutting-edge facial that uses LED light therapy to target specific skin concerns — from acne and inflammation to fine lines and dullness. Each light wavelength works deep beneath the surface to rejuvenate, heal, and restore your natural glow.

services.name: Ulthera Skin Tightening
services.description: A non-surgical lifting treatment that uses focused ultrasound energy to stimulate collagen production deep within the skin. Ulthera helps lift, firm, and tighten areas like the face, neck, and jawline — revealing a smoother, more youthful appearance with no downtime.

categories.title: Body Scrubs
categories.about: Reveal radiant, silky-smooth skin with Glamour Day Spa’s rejuvenating Body Scrub services.

services.name: Lavender Sugar Body Scrub
services.description: This treatment exfoliate your body with a blend of micro buffing beads and micronized bluff and micronized apricot seed powder. Gently polish away dead surface cells and skin-dulling debris to reveal smoother, softer skin beneath.

services.name: Back Polish
services.description: A refreshing treatment that deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and smooths the skin on your back. This polish removes impurities and dead skin cells while restoring softness and radiance — leaving your skin silky, hydrated, and glowing.

services.name: Lavender Sugar Body Scrub with Seaweed mask
services.description: Submerge yourself in the world of Deep Sea Therapy and feel the divine power of its healing energy. Seaweed, which has a high mineral content, is applied all over the body to help boost metabolism.

categories.title: Massages
categories.about: Unwind, recharge, and restore harmony with our diverse selection of massage therapies at Glamour Day Spa.

services.name: Anti-Stress Massage
services.description: A balanced massage that blends Swedish and Deep Tissue techniques to deliver both deep relaxation and effective pain relief, leaving your body restored, relaxed, and renewed.

services.name: Deep Tissue Massage
services.description: Deep tissue massage is designed for those who need more than light relaxation—it targets chronic tension and tight, overworked muscles.

services.name: Hot Stone Massage
services.description: A hot stone massage uses warm, smooth stones to gently melt away tension and relax tight muscles. The comforting heat helps improve circulation, softens stiff areas, and allows your therapist to work more deeply without added pressure.

services.name: Prenatal Massage
services.description: A prenatal massage is a calming, therapeutic treatment designed to ease common pregnancy discomforts, improve circulation, and promote relaxation for both mom and baby. With the support of extra pillows and gentle positioning, this service ensures complete comfort and safety throughout the 2nd and 3rd trimesters, helping you feel relaxed, supported, and refreshed.

services.name: Lymphatic Drainage Massage with Wood Therapy
services.description: Wood therapy uses specially designed wooden tools to help relax tight muscles, break down stubborn fat and cellulite, tone and sculpt the body, and stimulate healthy circulation.

services.name: Breast Enhancing Treatment
services.description: A natural, non-surgical treatment that enhances the size, shape, and firmness of the breasts.

services.name: Swedish Massage
services.description: A Swedish massage uses smooth, flowing strokes and soothing oils to gently release muscle tension, improve circulation, and promote deep, full-body relaxation.

services.name: Aromatherapy Massage
services.description: Aromatherapy massage combines the soothing techniques of a Swedish massage with the therapeutic benefits of essential oils.

services.name: Reflexology Massage
services.description: Reflexology uses gentle, targeted pressure on specific points of the feet, hands, or ears to encourage deep relaxation, improve circulation, reduce stress, and support the body’s natural balance.

services.name: Lymphatic Drainage Massage
services.description: A gentle, rhythmic massage that activates the lymphatic system to help flush out toxins, reduce swelling, and improve circulation.

services.name: Meridian Massage
services.description: Meridian Health therapy stimulates the body’s energy channels to help clear toxins, balance the flow of qi and blood, relieve symptoms, and support overall wellness.

services.name: Abdominal Massage
services.description: A soothing treatment using special herbal oils to relax the abdominal muscles, ease discomfort, and support healthy digestion. This gentle therapy helps relieve issues such as bloating and constipation, promoting a calmer, more balanced digestive system.

categories.title: Eyelash Extensions
categories.about: Enhance your natural beauty with our luxurious eyelash services at Glamour Day Spa.

services.name: Classic Full Set
services.description: A classic full set applies one extension to each of your natural lashes, giving you a natural yet beautifully enhanced look with added length and curl.

services.name: Glamour Full Set
services.description: A Glamour Full Set delivers a bold, dramatic lash look with maximum fullness and intensity. Using dense, carefully crafted volume fans, this style creates a striking, glamorous effect that stands out while still maintaining a soft, lightweight feel.

services.name: Eyelash Tinting
services.description: Eyelash tinting is a quick, painless treatment that darkens your natural lashes from root to tip. Using a safe, gentle dye, this service enhances the depth and definition of your lashes—making them look fuller and more noticeable without mascara.

services.name: Eyebrow Tinting
services.description: Eyebrow tinting is a quick and gentle treatment that adds color and definition to your natural brows. Using a safe, semi-permanent dye, this service enhances the shape, fills in lighter areas, and creates a more polished, fuller appearance.

services.name: Natural Full Set
services.description: A natural full set enhances your lashes with a soft, subtle boost that mimics your own lashes—just longer, neater, and slightly fuller.

services.name: Hybrid 3D / 5D Full Set
services.description: A Hybrid 3D/5D full set blends classic individual extensions with 3D–5D volume fans to create a beautifully textured, fuller look. This style offers the perfect balance between natural and dramatic, adding both definition and soft volume.

services.name: Eyelash Lifting
services.description: Eyelash lifting is a semi-permanent treatment that gently curls and lifts your natural lashes from the base, giving them a longer, more open and lifted appearance.

services.name: Eyelash Removal
services.description: Eyelash removal is a safe and gentle process used to dissolve and remove existing lash extensions without damaging your natural lashes. A professional-grade remover is applied to break down the adhesive, allowing the extensions to slide off comfortably.

categories.title: Head Spa
categories.about: Revitalize your scalp and restore balance with Glamour Day Spa’s luxurious Head Scalp services.

services.name: Head Scalp Massage
services.description: The Head Scalp Massage is a calming, therapeutic treatment designed to melt away stress and revitalized the senses.

services.name: Head Scalp Detoxification with Mini Facial
services.description: The Head Scalp Detoxification with Mini Facial is a restorative treatment designed to cleanse, refresh, and deeply rejuvenate both the scalp and skin.

services.name: Head Scalp Detoxification
services.description: The Head Scalp Detoxification treatment is a deeply refreshing experience designed to cleanse, soothe, and rejuvenate the scalp while promoting full-body relaxation.

categories.title: Waxing
categories.about: Experience smooth, glowing skin with our professional waxing services at Glamour Day Spa. Our expertly trained estheticians use high-quality wax to provide gentle, effective hair removal for both men and women.

categories.title: Permanent Makeup
categories.about: Enhance your natural beauty with Glamour Day Spa’s expert permanent makeup services.

services.name: Ombre Powder Brows
services.description: Ombre powder brows are a semi-permanent cosmetic tattoo technique that uses a digital machine to create a soft, shaded, powder-makeup effect.

services.name: Ombre Powder Brow Refill
services.description: An ombre powder brow refill is a maintenance session designed to refresh and enhance your existing ombre brows. During this appointment, pigment is added to areas that may have faded over time, restoring the soft gradient effect and overall definition.

services.name: Lip Blush Permament
services.description: Lip blush is a semi-permanent makeup treatment that enhances the lips by depositing pigment to create a soft, natural wash of color. The process begins with a consultation to select the ideal shade and shape, followed by numbing to ensure comfort.

services.name: Microblading
services.description: Microblading is a semi-permanent eyebrow treatment that uses a handheld tool with a small blade to create precise, hair-like strokes in sparse or thinning areas.

services.name: Eyeliner
services.description: Permanent eyeliner, also called an eyeliner tattoo, involves implanting pigment along the lash line to create a long-lasting makeup effect that typically lasts 1–3 years.

categories.title: Couple Packages
categories.about: Share a moment of bliss with our luxurious couples packages at Glamour Day Spa.

services.name: Couples Massage
services.description: Indulge in the ultimate romantic escape with our signature couples massage, designed to help you unwind and reconnect on a deeper level. Enjoy synchronized, soothing strokes that melt away tension, improve circulation, and rejuvenate your entire body.

services.name: Couples Signature Facials
services.description: Experience a revitalizing facial that deeply cleanses, exfoliates, and purifies the skin, followed by gentle steaming, precise extractions, and a nourishing hydrating mask.

services.name: Couples Hot Stone Massage
services.description: Celebrate love with our exclusive spa experience designed for pure indulgence. Begin with a deeply therapeutic 60-minute deep tissue massage enhanced with warm, soothing hot stones to melt away tension.
